vibe.verdict: A neat Chop Suey Palace takeaway with the leg lamp, flagpole and Bumpus hounds, but it leaves out the BB gun and the lines everyone quotes.
missing: The Red Ryder BB gun and 'You'll shoot your eye out' (Santa at Higbee's, Mother, Miss Shields)
'Be sure to drink your Ovaltine', the decoder pin message (Little Orphan Annie radio)
'Fra-GEE-leh, it must be Italian' (the leg lamp crate, the Old Man)
The triple dog dare at the flagpole (Schwartz and Flick)
Scut Farkus and Grover Dill in the schoolyard
ideas: Swap 'Chocolate malted milk' for 'Ovaltine', noted as 'a crummy commercial' (the decoder pin scene).
Swap the 'Schoolyard Dare' fortune for Santa's 'You'll shoot your eye out, kid.'
Swap 'Christmas sugar cookies' for 'Aunt Clara's pink bunny cookies' to bring in the bunny sleeper.
Move the duck cue to the family walking into the Chinese restaurant after the Bumpus hounds eat the turkey, so the duck and its scene line up.
